class.name: IfcEdgeLoop
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : An edge_loop is a loop with nonzero extent. It is a path in which the start and end vertices are the same. Its domain, if present, is a closed curve. An edge_loop may overlap itself. Informal propositions: The genus of the IfcEdgeLoop shall be 1 or greater. members.member: A list of oriented edge entities which are concatenated together to form this path.
